name: Survey tile in Leo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.4 degrees south of the ecliptic in Leo, imaged by SPHEREx 16 times in 6 visits over 69 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 32 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.9 days starting 2026-04-30, at wavelengths from 1.13 to 4.83 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
